nodes.title: How to Detail
widgets_values:
1. Load an image (PNG recommended), disable the `Detailer` and 'Run' to get as much of the original image generation details as possible: model, lora, steps, sample, scheduler, seed, positive and negative prompts too. **Note:** The positive prompt displayed is likely to also include the negative prompt (an issue with the custom node). 2. Enable the Detailer. Doing so will enable ALL the Models and Detailers, you will need to narrow the list down.
Select the expected model (01a toggles), set the parameters to match the original generation (only enable one model type). Set the LoRA and trigger words if possible to get as close as possible to the initial generation. 3. Select what to detail from the provided sub-list (01b) or modify the "Custom" entry (01b00) to match your needs. 4. Modify the exposed parameters of the "Detailer"; in particular the `denoise` for regular and small elements. You can define what "small" is based on the area of the source image it takes: for example a small face might take less that 1/8th of the image area and would require a higher denoise than a larger face. 6. Hit `Run` and decide if you like the result or want to try again with different parameters. 7. Use the saved image as the input to the next run to fix another component.
